editionData.title: Ecuadorian fishermen sue U.S. over drone attack they say sank their boat; In Manila, Trump praises Marcos family, 40 years after...
editionData.description: Global headlines: Ecuadorian fishermen sue U.S. over drone attack they say sank their boat (Crew members of La Negra Francisca Duarte II, which was attacked in March, filed the suit in federal court in the western district of Pennsylvania); In Manila, Trump praises Marcos family, 40 years after dictator was deposed (“I knew your parents very well. And they were great,” Trump told Philippine President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., whose father ruled as an autocrat until 1986); and Philippines government faces criticism over slum cleanup before Trump visit (Critics of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. say efforts to present a polished face to dignitaries in Manila echoed practices under his father’s authoritarian rule). Markets leaned higher, with 7 of 7 tracked indexes up; S&P 500 up 0.00% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Java4Shell: RCE in OpenJDK when processing Base64 (A memory-corruption vulnerability in OpenJDK); ID.me terms required for IRS sign-in (IRS sign-in through ID.me: its terms require arbitration absent a 30-day opt-out; government verification data is excluded from Shop...); and Quad9's withdrawal from France: A canary in the coal mine (Quad9's forced withdrawal from France highlights the dangers of mandating DNS-level blocking). Product Hunt features lepoly (One place for all your 3D assets), AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 (Speech-to-Text for live calls, voice agents, and recordings), and Pitch Avatar HR Suite (Onboarding, training & comms with conversational AI avatars).
editionData.author: Sony Mathew

headlines.title: Ecuadorian fishermen sue U.S. over drone attack they say sank their boat
headlines.summary: Crew members of La Negra Francisca Duarte II, which was attacked in March, filed the suit in federal court in the western district of Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: In Manila, Trump praises Marcos family, 40 years after dictator was deposed
headlines.summary: “I knew your parents very well. And they were great,” Trump told Philippine President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., whose father ruled as an autocrat until 1986.

headlines.title: Forum vital to boosting regional commerce, experts say
headlines.summary: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meetings in Shenzhen are bringing regional cooperation in supply chains, artificial intelligence and green development into focus, analysts said.

headlines.title: Nation lauded for fostering cohesive spirit
headlines.summary: As the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Economic Leaders' Meeting opens in Shenzhen, Guangdong province, experts have lauded China's proactive role as this year's APEC host in providing pragmatic solutions and fostering regional cohesion, especially at a time when unilateralism and protectionism threaten global economic development.

headlines.title: Southeast Asia eyes deeper cooperation

headlines.title: When cultures, the past and technology merge
headlines.summary: When Jiang Suxuan first saw micro-nanobots under a microscope in Shenzhen, those movements were familiar to her: the fluid, atmospheric brushstrokes of a classical Chinese landscape.
